final_topology.title: Resilient Branch Office Network
final_topology.description: Design for a branch office with redundant routers, MPLS WAN connectivity, and survivable voice capabilities.
final_topology.topology_summary: The branch office will have redundant routers connected via MPLS to the main data center. It will also have direct connections to the PSTN and a SIP provider for survivable voice functionality.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Inventory System' (n21) in the 'Asset Management' zone (z7), which is connected to the primary and secondary routers (n1, n2). This suggests that the system is used to manage and maintain an asset inventory.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Data Flow Documentation System' (n22) in the 'Asset Management' zone (z7), which is connected to the primary and secondary routers (n1, n2). This suggests that the system is used to document data flows.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple zones such as 'Data Center' (z2), 'Management Zone' (z3), 'Security Zone' (z4), 'Non-Production Zone' (z5), and 'External Testing Zone' (z6), which suggests that data processing and storage are segmented based on sensitivity.

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Admin Workstation' (n19) in the 'Management Zone' (z3), which is connected to both the primary and secondary routers (n1, n2). This suggests that network infrastructure is securely managed.

controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Central AAA Server' (n14) in the 'Management Zone' (z3), which is connected to both the primary and secondary routers (n1, n2). This suggests that network AAA is centralized.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Remote Access Controller' (n24) in the 'Remote Access' zone (z8), which is connected to both the primary and secondary routers (n1, n2). This suggests that access control for remote assets is managed.

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Netflow Collector' (n7) in the 'Data Center' zone (z2), which is connected to both the primary and secondary routers (n1, n2). This suggests that network traffic flow logs are collected.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Non-Production Zone' (z5) and a 'Data Center' (z2), which suggests that production and non-production systems are separated.

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Penetration Testing Host' (n20) and a 'Penetration Testing Process' (n25) in the 'External Testing Zone' (z6), which suggests that periodic external penetration tests are performed.
